title: Engage-forge synthesis output (comparison table, NOT merger)
description: Synthesis output for engage-forge. The output is a comparison table across paths — different artefact types are structurally distinct and cannot be coherently combined, so merger is rejected at the schema level. The only sanctioned cross-path combination is the operational-graft mechanism in Step 4 (heuristic audit), which produces a structural element transplant — not a merged artefact.

outputType.description: Must literally be the string 'comparison-table'. Any other outputType — including 'merged-artefact', 'hybrid', 'fused-artefact' — fails validation with the engage-forge synthesis-is-comparison-not-merger diagnostic.

recommendedPath.description: Optional. The path number recommended for the audit + critique passes. Null when no clear winner emerges from the comparison; the user is asked to pick before audit/critique runs.
